name: 77 - DB - Add Patient Consents and Communication Preferences

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_consents (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    patient_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES patients(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    consent_type TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            consent_type IN (
                'contact',
                'profile_storage',
                'document_storage',
                'appointment_reminders',
                'followup_messages',
                'marketing_messages',
                'satisfaction_surveys',
                'data_processing'
            )
        ),

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'pending',
                'granted',
                'revoked',
                'expired'
            )
        ),

    policy_version TEXT,
    scope_json JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    source_channel TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'api'
        CHECK (
            source_channel IN (
                'web',
                'whatsapp',
                'telegram',
                'sms',
                'email',
                'phone',
                'manual',
                'api',
                'system'
            )
        ),

    granted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    last_actor TEXT,
    last_reason TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    UNIQUE (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        consent_type
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_consent_events (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    patient_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES patients(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    consent_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES patient_consents(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    consent_type TEXT NOT NULL,

    event_type TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            event_type IN (
                'granted',
                'revoked',
                'expired',
                'preference_changed',
                'status_checked',
                'imported'
            )
        ),

    previous_status TEXT,
    new_status TEXT,

    actor_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_channel TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'api',

    policy_version TEXT,
    reason TEXT,
    event_payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_communication_preferences (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    patient_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES patients(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    channel TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            channel IN (
                'whatsapp',
                'sms',
                'email',
                'phone',
                'web_push',
                'in_app'
            )
        ),

    enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    preferred_language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fa'
        CHECK (
            preferred_language IN (
                'fa',
                'en',
                'ar',
                'unknown'
            )
        ),

    timezone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Baghdad',

    quiet_hours_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    quiet_hours_start TIME,
    quiet_hours_end TIME,

    max_messages_per_week INTEGER
        CHECK (
            max_messages_per_week IS NULL
            OR max_messages_per_week BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        ),

    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    updated_by TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    UNIQUE (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        channel
    ),

    CHECK (
        quiet_hours_enabled = FALSE
        OR (
            quiet_hours_start IS NOT NULL
            AND quiet_hours_end IS NOT NULL
        )
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS communication_permission_checks (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    patient_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES patients(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    channel TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose TEXT NOT NULL,

    decision TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            decision IN (
                'allowed',
                'blocked',
                'deferred',
                'error'
            )
        ),

    decision_reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    next_allowed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    consent_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    preference_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    request_reference TEXT,
    checked_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_patient_consents_current
    ON patient_consents(
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        consent_type,
        status
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_patient_consent_events_recent
    ON patient_consent_events(
        patient_id,
        created_at DESC
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_communication_preferences_patient
    ON patient_communication_preferences(
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        channel
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_permission_checks_recent
    ON communication_permission_checks(
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        checked_at DESC
    );

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'migration_completed' AS result,
    'ساختار رضایت بیمار، ترجیحات ارتباطی و ثبت کنترل مجوز پیام ایجاد شد.' AS message;

parameters.content:
## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

ساختارهای زیر ایجاد می‌شوند:
- رضایت‌های جاری بیمار
- تاریخچه تغییر رضایت
- ترجیحات هر کانال
- ثبت نتیجه بررسی مجوز ارسال پیام

این Migration جایگزین فیلدهای ساده پروفایل نمی‌شود؛ لایه متمرکز و قابل‌ممیزی روی آن‌ها می‌سازد.
